newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran police clash with smugglers, seize drugs.
newsitem.headline: Iran police clash with smugglers, seize drugs.

text.p: Police in southeast Iran seized some 520-kg (1,144-lb) of narcotics after clashing with armed smugglers, the Iranian news agency (IRNA) said on Tuesday.
Ten armed smugglers were arrested and one was killed in the clashes in the cities of Taibad, Khaf, Torbatejam and Bojnourd over the last two days, it added.

Iran, where officials say there are about half-a-million drug addicts, is a key transit route for narcotics smuggled to Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan -- the so-called "Golden Crescent".
Iran's acting police commander, in remarks published on Tuesday, said his office had seized 110 tonnes of narcotics in the past four months.
"That (quantity) is 10 tonnes more than even twice the period last year," Brigadier Mohsen Ansari told Kayhan daily.
Ansari said police has set up 15 battalions in the eastern parts of the country near the borders with Afghanistan and Pakistan.
